description: This file defines a UI class for a dialog in a PySide6 (Qt for Python) application, generated from a Qt Designer UI file. It contains layout and widget setup code for a dialog that manages modifiers, including their creation, modification, ordering, and loading from files.

classes.name: Ui_Dialog
classes.description: A class representing the UI layout and setup for a dialog to manage modifiers, generated automatically from a Qt Designer .ui file.

methods.name: setupUi(self, Dialog)
methods.description: Initializes and arranges all UI widgets within the provided dialog object.

methods.name: retranslateUi(self, Dialog)
methods.description: Sets the text of UI components—used for supporting multiple languages.
